visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with voluminous, copper-colored hair sits in a white styling chair inside a professional salon. A male stylist standing directly behind her holds her hair upward with both hands to frame her face, creating a dramatic halo effect. The environment is brightly lit with professional studio-style lighting, and white walls are visible in the background. (2) The male stylist pulls the top section of the copper hair down, revealing a darker, blue-black wavy hairstyle underneath in a quick reveal. The woman shifts her gaze from downward to the camera, displaying a subtle smile while wearing a beige ribbed top and a silver chain necklace. (3) The stylist uses a sleek, gray and orange handheld hairdryer to blow the woman's long waves, causing the hair to flow dynamically. The woman laughs and smiles joyfully, looking toward the camera as if viewing herself in a mirror, while Chinese variety-show style text bubbles appear periodically in the corners.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music begins with a clear male vocal singing the lyrics 'Somebody's watching me.' The music has a driving synthesizer bassline and a steady electronic drum beat. No significant ambient noise is present. (2) The audio transitions into a rhythmic loop where the male vocal repeats the word 'anxiety' in a stylized, percussive manner. The synthesizer melody becomes more repetitive, matching the visual shift in the video. (3) A continuous, high-frequency 'whoosh' sound from a hairdryer enters the mix, functioning as a sustained noise layer. Simultaneously, a female voice can be heard laughing heartily with high pitch and positive energy, overlapping the background music and the hairdryer sound.
